req.title: Delete unknown returns 404
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 404 when DELETE targets a non-existent task id.

doc.reasoning: R-TASK-014 requires DELETE /tasks/{task_id} to return HTTP 404 when the task_id does not exist. The table is EMPTY before every test, so any task_id is non-existent by default. We need: (1) a positive case confirming a real task can be deleted with 204 (proves the endpoint works correctly and the 404 path is not always triggered), (2) a negative/EP case confirming a non-existent id returns exactly 404 with the correct detail message, (3) a BVA case using task_id=0 (below the minimum valid auto-increment id) to confirm 404, (4) a STC case that creates then deletes a task (204) then attempts to delete again (404) — verifying the state transition from 'exists' to 'deleted' triggers 404, (5) a DT case using a very large non-existent id to confirm 404. All tests use in-process FastAPI TestClient with SQLite in-memory override to avoid touching the file-based tasks.db.

tests.name: test_delete_existing_task_returns_204
preconditions: A task is created via POST /tasks/ to obtain a valid task_id
actions: POST /tasks/ with title='cleanup me' to create a task
trace: R-TASK-014: confirms the non-404 path works (EP positive partition), catches mutations that always return 404 or change 204 constant
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker
from app.main import app
from app.database import get_db, Base

engine_mem = create_engine('sqlite://', connect_args={'check_same_thread': False})
SessionMem = sessionmaker(autocommit=False, autoflush=False, bind=engine_mem)
Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine_mem)

def override_get_db():
    db = SessionMem()
    try:
        yield db
    finally:
        db.close()

app.dependency_overrides[get_db] = override_get_db
client = TestClient(app)

def test_delete_existing_task_returns_204():
    r_create = client.post('/tasks/', json={'title': 'cleanup me', 'completed': False})
    assert r_create.status_code == 201
    task_id = r_create.json()['id']
    r_delete = client.delete(f'/tasks/{task_id}')
    assert r_delete.status_code == 204
    assert r_delete.content == b''

actions: Assert status code is NOT any 2xx value
expected: HTTP 404 exactly — not 200, not 204, not any 2xx
